CREATION_RULE_CONTEXT.NETWORK_ENVIRONMENT_CONSTRAINTS: network_mode public; separate verifier; digest-pinned canonical Go runtime; no privileged Docker/capability/socket shortcuts; tmux and asciinema required in agent image

required.REQUESTED_DOMAIN: production Go EC2 software supply-chain and artifact policy enforcement

failure_routes.DUPLICATE_RISK: A1 Scenario Researcher / Originality & Authenticity Reviewer

CANDIDATES.DUPLICATE_RISK: Moderate generic supply-chain overlap; the coupled multi-surface cache/exception/permit/audit/recovery boundary is materially differentiated.
EDGE_FAILURE_SURFACE: mutable reference resolving to a new digest
CANDIDATES.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Make package, container, and build-dependency acquisition converge on one host-local Go admission boundary that enforces artifact identity, source trust, current vulnerability evidence, scoped exceptions, permit integrity, and durable decision state.
PRESERVATION_OBLIGATIONS: preserve evaluate and verify-permit interfaces and documented exits
keep healthy cache and exact exceptions operational
retain stateless permit verification while stateful verification is durable and single-use
CANDIDATES.REASONING_CHAIN: normalize acquisition context -> establish trusted source and immutable digest -> select fresh scanner/cache evidence -> evaluate vulnerability threshold and exact exception -> issue or verify bound permit -> atomically journal decision/consumption -> recover and project durable state
CANDIDATES.REQUIRED_END_STATE: Every acquisition surface applies the same prerequisite trust and immutable-identity rules, uses only current artifact/policy/scanner evidence, limits exceptions to exact vulnerability scope, safely issues and consumes exact-scope keyed permits, and commits restart-safe ALLOW/DENY history before completion.
REQUIREMENT_FAMILIES: durable journal, projection, corruption handling, and idempotency
CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: VERY_HIGH: the remediated starter realizes these responsibilities as production-reachable modules rather than catalog padding.

CANDIDATES.DUPLICATE_RISK: Higher because scanner/cache freshness is a common supply-chain theme.
CANDIDATES.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Make reusable scan evidence exact-identity and revision-aware across policy/scanner changes while preserving fail-closed availability behavior.
CANDIDATES.REASONING_CHAIN: resolve artifact -> active revisions -> scanner/cache selection -> freshness -> atomic persistence -> evaluate -> recover
CANDIDATES.REQUIRED_END_STATE: Only exact immutable artifact and active revision evidence is reusable; unavailable scanners never become clean evidence; partial/stale state fails closed and restart recovery converges safely.
CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: MEDIUM_HIGH but narrower than the inherited system.

CANDIDATES.DUPLICATE_RISK: Moderate; durable authorization is familiar but the crash/replay coupling is nontrivial.
CANDIDATES.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Harden exact-scope keyed permits and crash-safe single-use authorization with durable, idempotent decision history.
CANDIDATES.REASONING_CHAIN: bind scope -> sign -> verify -> atomically consume -> journal/fsync -> projection -> restart recovery
CANDIDATES.REQUIRED_END_STATE: Permits are keyed, exact-scope, unexpired, atomically consumed when stateful; authoritative ALLOW/DENY history is crash-safe and recovery preserves valid committed state while rejecting corruption.
CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: HIGH but underuses the three acquisition surfaces.

outputs.WHY_THIS_ONE: It is the only candidate that uses the remediated production-shaped starter end-to-end: all three acquisition surfaces, exact identity/source gates, current evidence/cache semantics, scoped exceptions, keyed permit authorization, restart/concurrency replay protection, and durable journal/recovery behavior are causally coupled and naturally satisfy large_system_strict without artificial breadth.
